For docket 2002-NM-12-AD, the proposed AD on relocating or replacing resistor R170 in the static inverter on Boeing 737, 747-400, 757, 767 and 777 airplanes, which version is the latest, and has the proposal been revised or withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is still pending and was never withdrawn in these entries. The original NPRM (2002-05-10) was revised by a first supplemental NPRM (2006-05-15), which was revised again by a second supplemental NPRM (2008-12-18). The 2008-12-18 notice is the latest version.

query: What is the current status of the FAA proposal under docket FAA-2013-0751 to supersede the AD on Agusta AB139 and AW139 tail rotor blades? Is it still open for comment, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The FAA issued the NPRM on 2013-08-21 to supersede AD 2011-18-52 (tail rotor blade life limit, inspection and replacement for Agusta AB139/AW139 helicopters). It was formally withdrawn by a notice issued 2021-01-21 (doc 2021-03661), so there is no open comment period.

query: For docket FAA-2025-5394, the proposed AD on restricted category CH-47D helicopters about cracking of the RH forward transmission support beam fitting, is the original December 2025 NPRM still the current version, or has it been revised?
gold_status: The original NPRM (doc 2025-23613, issued 2025-12-17) has been superseded by a revised NPRM (supplemental NPRM, doc 2026-13781, issued 2026-07-02). The revision expands the required actions to cover all RH forward transmission support beam fittings with any part number, narrows the inspection area, and increases the reporting compliance times. The proposal has not been withdrawn and remains an active proposal. The latest version is 2026-13781.

query: Is the proposed airworthiness directive for Sikorsky S-92A helicopters under docket FAA-2010-0720 (reducing the main gearbox housing life limit) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: It is no longer active. The FAA withdrew the NPRM in a notice issued 2021-01-25 (doc 2021-05194), so the proposed AD requiring a reduced life limit and replacement of the main gearbox housing will not be adopted under this docket. The original proposal was issued 2010-07-13.

query: Is the FAA proposal under docket FAA-2017-0313 for CFM56-7B fan blade ultrasonic inspections still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: It is no longer active. The FAA withdrew the NPRM (the proposed AD for CFM International CFM56-7B engines, published in August 2017) in a notice issued 2018-09-17. The agency determined the proposed actions did not adequately address the unsafe condition and instead published two final rules that do. No comment deadline remains open.

query: For FAA docket FAA-2011-0099 (the proposed AD on Sikorsky S-76 helicopters with the life raft deployment system installed under STC SR09211RC), which notice is the most recent, and is the proposal still active or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal appears to still be active. Nothing in the entries shows it was withdrawn. The docket has two entries: the original NPRM issued 2011-01-27 and a later NPRM, document 2021-01623, issued 2021-01-20. The later one has the same description (remove and replace the pilot/co-pilot life raft deployment handle). It appears to be a re-issued proposal and is the latest version. The entries give no final rule and no comment deadline.
